place.display_name: Simpang Hulu, Ketapang, West Kalimantan, 78850, Indonesia

report.cause_detail: Forest and land fires in Ketapang Regency, West Kalimantan. No specific entity named as responsible for clearing the land.

evidence.claim: Forest and land fires in Ketapang reached 12,000 hectares (S1).
628 hotspots detected in Ketapang; police processed 30 forest fire reports (S2).
Two orangutans trapped by forest fires were found in a palm-oil plantation in Pelang Village, Matan, Ketapang (S3).
Eight orangutan victims of forest fires were released into Batu Nyambu Protected Forest in Ketapang (S4).
West Kalimantan strengthened forest-fire response with troops deployed to Ketapang and North Kayong (S5).

inferences.claim: The reported events are all about forest fires, not land conversion for plantations or other uses.
inferences.basis: All cited sources describe fire incidents and emergency responses.

inferences.claim: No company, concession, or plantation name is mentioned as the cause of the loss at the plot’s coordinates.
inferences.basis: None of the sources identify an actor responsible for clearing the land.

caveats: Search results only cover recent fire events; no reporting on land-clearing activities was found.
A single mention of a palm-oil plantation in S3 does not link it to the plot’s location.
